# Java Audiveris 5.11 (Temurin JDK 25.0.3+9 LTS) HEADS range-pass oracle.
#
# Every target reaches real LEDGERS and runs real HEADS prolog in a fresh JVM.
# Each non-tablature staff invokes actual processStaff(staff,true), appends and
# ordinate-sorts those seed heads into systemCompetitors, then invokes actual
# processStaff(staff,false), exactly as buildHeads. Duplicate and overlap purge,
# tally purge, staff-note attachment, beam purge, and linking never run.
#
# Private range lookup is replayed against identical pre-range state to expose
# safety skips, black relevance and shape selection, every evaluation and best
# update, abandonment, black-to-void conversion, weak-stemless rejection,
# aggregation, dynamic seed-head conflicts, and predicted glyph construction.
# Replay counters are restored before production and asserted equal afterward.
#
# The default runner hashes and omits headrangescan, headrangeattempt, and
# headrangerawcandidate diagnostics. Pass --full-trace to retain them.
# Compact candidate rows are post-aggregation; final rows freeze production SIG
# order, impacts, glyph bounds, weights, and complete vertical-run digests.
# Doubles are Double.toHexString/raw-bits. Row and run digests are FNV-1a-64
# over canonical UTF-8 records with trailing newlines.
#
# Generate one target per fresh JVM: chula, allegretto, batuque, carmen,
# cucaracha, hove, zizi, BachInvention5.
